title: Canonical rational twisted pullback compositor
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension, and $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use the raw rational constructible categories [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], their specified completed derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and Tate coefficients [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For $d,e\in\mathbf N$, write $B_{r,W}=E_W(r)[2r]$ and $H_{h,r}(K)=B_{r,\mathrm{source}(h)}\otimes^L Lh^*K$, in the source coordinates of [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports]. Define the natural isomorphism $u_{f,g,d,e}:H_{gf,d+e}\xrightarrow{\sim}H_{f,d}H_{g,e}$ as follows. Identify each $B_{r,W}$ with the rationalization of the one-term integral root-line complex in degree $-2r$ using the canonical localization and single-complex shift comparisons. The multiplication $B_{d,X}\otimes^L B_{e,X}\to B_{d+e,X}$ and the pullback $Lf^*B_{e,Y}\to B_{e,X}$ are the rationalizations of the root-normalized one-term product and pullback of [def-sf-orientation-integral-line-comparisons]. Tensor the inverse multiplication with the pullback compositor $L(gf)^*\to Lf^*Lg^*$; apply the tensor associator, the inverse line-pullback in the $e$ block, and the inverse monoidal pullback comparison. All associators, pullback compositors and monoidal maps are those of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Their ordered composite is $u$, naturally in every rational object. No purity isomorphism enters its construction.

proof.text: For the naturality obligation, use the integral pullback compositor of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]. Its naturality square holds on integral arrows. The pure-tensor formula of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the normalization in [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] identify both rational composites with the same scalar times this square. Tensor-product induction extends the equation to every rational arrow.

The tensor reduction comparison in [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] is natural: it is reduction of the normalized tensor-model comparison followed by the reconstruction counit. Coherent reduction is faithful by [lem-pod-integral-system-reduction-fully-faithful]. Conjugate the natural system associator through this comparison, and use the defining integral associator equation to obtain naturality in the third variable. Its localization normalization and the bilinear pure-tensor formula of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] give the corresponding rational square, first on pure tensors and then on sums.

Use the rational monoidal pullback natural isomorphism of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso] with its first argument the fixed shifted line. Compose its inverse with inverse line pullback. Tensoring with a fixed isomorphism is natural by functoriality. Paste this square with the preceding two squares and the fixed inverse line multiplication. The outside square is component_naturality for the already defined component, so NatIso.ofComponents defines the compositor without changing any canonical factor.

proof_origin.place: Naturality of the five canonical factors in the composition-transport construction; P1 gives explicit coherent-reduction and pure-tensor calculations for the existing definitions.
